acceptance.criterion: The whole module compiles after moving lease validation out of the apply loop
Storage and types tests pass, including the new rejected-update no-op test and the per-column schema probe loop
go vet is clean over the storage packages
The full test suite passes, so no other caller depended on the partial-update behavior

implementation.item_1: internal/storage/memory/memory.go: added resolveClaimExpiry(updates), called before issue.UpdatedAt is touched and before the apply loop. The loop's claim_expires_at arm now only assigns the pre-resolved value, so UpdateIssue has no error return inside the loop and a rejected value changes nothing (no field write, no updated_at bump, no dirty mark, no event).
implementation.item_2: internal/storage/sqlite/schema_probe_test.go: TestProbeSchema_DetectsDroppedClaimExpiresAt replaced by TestProbeSchema_DetectsEveryDroppedIssuesColumn, a subtest per column of expectedSchema["issues"] that rebuilds the issues table without that column and asserts verifySchemaCompatibility returns ErrSchemaIncompatible naming it. ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN cannot express this for 10 of the 32 columns (SQLite refuses the primary key and every indexed column, is_template among them), so the helper rebuildIssuesWithout recreates the table from pragma_table_info minus the target. A literal anchor asserts the probe still lists "claim_expires_at" and "is_template" by name, since a column deleted from expectedSchema is one the loop can no longer iterate.
